title: THE SECRET OF THE GOLDEN SCOOTER REVEALED! 🔑
topic: The truth behind the golden scooter and Nix's upgraded bike.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: WHERE IS MY BIKE [beat] AND WHY IS THERE A GIANT GOLDEN BOW WRAPPED AROUND THIS RUSTY PIECE OF JUNK!?

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: That junk is actually your old bike [beat] but I think you will find the hidden engine I installed makes it worth more than a luxury car.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Uncle Jamal [beat] are you telling me you stole my only ride just to turn it into some kind of super-secret undercover machine?

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: He did it because you gave up your seat on the bus to that tired lady last week [beat] and true kindness always finds its way back to you.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Wait so the whole drama with that expensive golden scooter [beat] was just a massive distraction while Jamal worked on this beast in the shed?

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Exactly [beat] the golden scooter was just a rental I used to see if you would get greedy or stay humble while walking home in those shoes.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I spent three days complaining about my painful blisters [beat] while my actual bike was being turned into a literal rocket ship in your garage?

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: We had to make sure you appreciated the journey Nix [beat] because a fast ride is totally meaningless if you do not have a good heart to guide it.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I feel like a complete idiot for shouting at everyone [beat] especially since I thought the neighbors stole my only way to get to school every morning.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Do not sweat the small stuff kid [beat] just hop on and see what happens when you finally hit that big red button under the leather handlebars.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: If Nix is too chicken to ride that mechanical monster [beat] then I am definitely claiming it as my own personal gamer-inspired transport device!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Get your hands off my property Riku [beat] because this kindness currency just bought me the coolest and fastest ride in the entire neighborhood!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nix finally learned that sometimes the best upgrades in life [beat] come from the things you do when you think nobody is actually watching you.
